text:
Tipos de POO
Terminologia de Chambers, “Extending R”, 2016 (apud (Wickham 2019, 287))
OOP encapsulada (POO clássica ):

objetos contém dados e métodos
Métodos pertencem a objetos e classes
object.method(arg1, arg2).
encapsulada pois o objeto encapsula dados e comportamento (métodos).
Objetos são mutáveis

title: Python versus R? Python no R!
section: Sistemas de POO no R - Nativos:
text:
Sistemas de POO no R - Nativos:

S3 (1992), POO funcional.

S4 (1998), POO funcional. “includes more formal class definitions and validation”.

RC (Reference Class). POO encapsulada. ” a special type of S4 that also allows objects to be modified in place. Reference classes have very low adoption within the R community, and are not widely used.”

title: Python versus R? Python no R!
section: Sistemas de POO no R - Pacotes Adicionais:
text:
Sistemas de POO no R - Pacotes Adicionais:

OOP is defunct and no longer available.
R.oo [Bengtsson, 2003]

proto [Grothendieck et al., 2016]. “had a brief moment of popularity as the underlying system in early versions of the ggplot2 package but is no longer really used.”
ggproto, “All ggplot2 objects are built using the ggproto system for object-oriented programming, and is unusual in that it is used only by ggplot2… Attempts to switch ggplot2 to other systems such as R6 (Chang 2020) proved difficult, and creating an object-oriented system specific to the needs of ggplot2 turned out to be the least bad solution.” link
R5 e mutatr: “R5 and mutatr were both experimental systems that never made it into real-world use before being abandoned. It’s almost impossible to use these, even if you wanted to.” Fonte: Datacamp.
R6 [Winston Chang, 2017]. “It’s primarily been developed by Posit (formerly RStudio) and is used within the Shiny package.”

S7, S7 website 2022, (previamente chamado de “R7”), “designed to be the successor to S3 and S4”, “built on top of S3, S7 objects are S3 objects.”link
